messages:
devex_alex: FYI I'm opening a docs PR for the offline/private upgrade path 1.3 -> 1.4. Main gaps: KMS proxy cert rotation steps, offline bundle import, and new installer cache layout. Need eng-infra + security review before merge.

docs_nina: thanks — can you drop a short checklist of the manual steps you expect operators to run? I can wire that into the Upgrade Guide and add a minimal CLI example.

eng-infra-raj: +1. Also can we call out the registry import command for air-gapped installs? sequence should be: import bundle -> update repo -> restart installer.service -> rotate certs. Porting note: no external egress required if bundle has certs and images.

security_sam: please ensure we include PKCS#11 HSM fallback notes. If HSM is unreachable during rotation we should show how to set REDWOOD_KMS_FALLBACK=true temporarily (we have a short-lived env var for that). Also need an auditable step for cert thumbprints.

devex_alex: draft checklist below, pulling from notes (will paste into PR body):
- Verify offline bundle checksum
- Import bundle to local registry: `./tools/import-bundle.sh /tmp/bundle_v1.4.tar.gz`
- Update installer cache dir: `/var/lib/redwood/installer/v1.4`
- Restart installer: `systemctl restart redwood-installer`
- Run KMS proxy cert rotation (see snippet)
- Validate PKCS#11 HSM connectivity and rotate token if needed

devex_alex: KMS proxy cert rotation snippet (add to Ops appendix):
```
# generate new cert/key on admin host
openssl req -new -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout kms-proxy.key -out kms-proxy.csr -subj '/CN=kms-proxy.local'
openssl x509 -req -in kms-proxy.csr -signkey kms-proxy.key -days 365 -out kms-proxy.crt
# copy to each node and reload systemd unit
scp kms-proxy.crt kms-proxy.key node1:/etc/redwood/kms-proxy/
ssh node1 'systemctl reload redwood-kms-proxy'
```

docs_nina: nice, can we also include the systemd unit snippet to show the reload behavior? I can format it in the PR.

eng-infra-raj: here's the minimal unit we use (paste into docs):
```
[Unit]
Description=Redwood KMS Proxy
After=network.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/redwood-kms-proxy --config /etc/redwood/kms-proxy/config.yaml
ExecReload=/bin/kill -HUP $MAINPID
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

security_sam: add this note: when rotating certs, capture the old cert fingerprint: `openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256 -in kms-proxy.crt` and append to the audit file `/var/log/redwood/cert-rotations.log`. Also mention HSM: if PKCS11 token ID changes, operator must update `/etc/redwood/kms-pkcs11.conf` and run `redwood-kmsctl reload`.

pm_olivia: ETA for review/merge? we're trying to bundle this into the 1.4 release notes.
